description: Elephantus evaluation scenarios. Each scenario's messages are added (one per simulated hour, after shared background 'filler' messages) to a fresh container; the question is asked at ask_at_hours. 'expected' is a list of facts, each a list of alternative keywords (matched at word starts, case-insensitive). 'stale' lists keywords of outdated/expired facts.

My favourite cuisine is Thai food.
I play the guitar on weekends.
